thread:
Priya Menon: Heads-up — 45m sync today 3pm PT to prep for the NovaHealth stakeholder readiness touchpoint. Need final slide list + top exec asks.
Marco Li: I can take slides for adoption + product usage. Will add a short summary slide.
Samira Khan: I'll pull onboarding status and list of outstanding enablement sessions. One customer had trouble completing the inference tutorial last week.
Ethan Park: I'll drop latency/cost numbers and the last 30-day trend. FYI there was a small spike on 3/8 due to a batch test.
Jared Cole: Renewal health is leaning amber — risk tied to a billing question and a delayed integration. AE flagged potential churn if not resolved in 2 weeks.
Priya Menon: Ok — owners: Marco (slides), Samira (onboarding + blockers), Ethan (metrics), Jared (renewal risks + AE notes). I'll draft the exec asks and the recommended mitigations.
Samira Khan: Quick ask — can we include an enablement heatmap? shows which teams completed training and which need follow-up.
Marco Li: Yep, will add a 1-slide heatmap. Can someone share the latest training roster?
Ethan Park: @Samira uploading roster CSV to this thread in 5. Also adding a chart: peak latency, p50/p95, token spend.
Olivia (CS-Bot): Reminder: attach final slide deck to thread before 2:30pm PT to allow QA pass. :alarm_clock:
Jared Cole: For the renewal ask: propose a 3-month technical success plan + a credits-based pilot for the delayed integration. Need exec sign-off on the credits.
Priya Menon: Good. Add a clear success metric for those 3 months (e.g., integration completion, <100ms median inference on prod, 10% uplift in user flows).
Samira Khan: I'll capture enablement follow-ups as action items with owners and ETA.
Marco Li: Draft slide outline I'm pushing now:
```
- Title: NovaHealth stakeholder readout
- Health snapshot: Onboarding / Adoption / Support tickets
- Metrics: Latency / Cost / Usage trends
- Enablement: heatmap + next steps
- Risks & mitigation: renewal ask + technical plan
- Ask: Exec approvals required
```
Ethan Park: One more note — include a line about the recent model quantization trial and expected cost delta (~12% savings). Helps justify credits pilot.
Jared Cole: AE will prepare a short customer quote on business impact — will add to the slides.

- Marco: finalize slides (due 2:10pm PT)
- Ethan: upload metrics images & CSV (due 1:50pm PT)

- Priya: consolidate exec asks + send to leadership (due 2:30pm PT)
